title: Canonical TV identity and queue consistency
summary: Unified Python, PowerShell, Queue dry-run, destination, apply, sidecar, and undo handling around a canonical range-aware TV identity. Queue discovery now parses each TV entry once and snapshots reuse that evidence; uploader revisions such as the supplied SubsPlease 12v2 case remain runnable and produce a clean S01E12 Plex destination.
reason: TV identity was interpreted through different regexes and at different times, which allowed uploader revision suffixes and three-digit episodes to disagree across naming and Queue surfaces and dropped multi-episode endpoints from downstream evidence.
behavior_before: PowerShell could truncate three-digit episodes, Queue discovery and snapshots could parse the same TV file differently, multi-episode endpoints were not preserved across every rename seam, and metadata-like lexical title words could be removed globally.
behavior_after: Seasons 0-99 and episodes 1-999 share strict parsing; canonical ranges normalize to SxxEyy-Ezz while invalid ranges block; Specials use the new Specials destination; revisions, episode titles, range endpoints, fingerprints, sidecars, conflicts, apply plans, and undo evidence remain consistent; reliable Queue rows sort canonically before visible blocked rows.
manual_validation: Bundled Python unittest: 83 focused TV/planner/apply/undo/preview/facade policy tests passed.
Invoke-NamingSupportChecks.ps1 passed, including canonical ranges, E100/E1000, revisions, ordinals, Specials, numeric titles, lexical metadata words, and exact SubsPlease destination.
Invoke-PipelineQueueEngineChecks.ps1 passed, including exact SubsPlease runnable snapshot, canonical ordering, unreliable-row blocking, and parse-once reuse.
Invoke-LibraryIndexCacheChecks.ps1 passed after range-aware identity keys.
Ruff passed on all Packet 2 Python source and test files.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet's parser, destination, Queue cache, identity-evidence, and regression-test changes together; retain MP-CHANGE-2026-0712-014 if only the original bare 12v2 correction is desired.
notes:
Packet 2 preserves the existing SubsPlease v2 work from MP-CHANGE-2026-0712-014 and extends it with canonical range identity, parse-once Queue evidence, Specials destinations, and interval conflict protection.
Refreshed generated summaries for every Packet 2 source and test touch.
No representative real-media validation is required: validation used filename/config planning and disposable temporary media-plus-sidecar fixtures without FFmpeg, publish, scratch, or source-media processing.
